title: Sprite Tejas Express Becomes India’s First Brand-Named Train
summary: The Lucknow-Delhi Tejas Express, train numbers 82501 and 82502, will run as the Sprite Tejas Express under a commercial branding arrangement. The Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation manages the train’s branding and services, whi...

blocks.content: The Lucknow-Delhi Tejas Express, train numbers 82501 and 82502, will run as the Sprite Tejas Express under a commercial branding arrangement. The Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation manages the train’s branding and services, while Indian Railways continues to own the railway infrastructure and collect standard hauling charges.

items: IRCTC stands for Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation.
Tejas Express trains are air-conditioned superfast trains in India.
Train numbers 82501 and 82502 are associated with the Lucknow-Delhi Tejas Express.
Non-fare revenue in Indian Railways includes advertising and branding rights.
